title: GE: Good Ending
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A shy high school boy (Seiji Utsumi on Wikipedia; 'Eiji' in Kodansha's blurb) has a crush on a popular girl on the tennis team. A classmate, Yuki Kurokawa, catches him peeping at her, pulls him into the tennis club and coaches him on how to win his crush, but he gradually falls for Yuki, who is wary of relationships because of her past. A shonen romantic drama about first love, misunderstandings and growing up.
life_message: Growing up means learning what you really feel and having the courage to say it.
